---
title: "Análises Ecológicas no R receives the SORTEE Commendation Award"
description: "The open textbook was recognised by SORTEE at its annual virtual conference."
date: "2026-10-14"
categories: [recognition]
---

[*Análises Ecológicas no R*](https://analises-ecologicas.com), the free open
textbook written by **Fernando Rodrigues da Silva**, **Thiago
Gonçalves-Souza**, **Gustavo Brant Paterno**, **Diogo Borges Provete** and
**Maurício Humberto Vancine**, has received the **SORTEE Commendation Award**
from the Society for Open, Reliable, and Transparent Ecology and Evolutionary
Biology.

The award recognises projects that promote open, transparent and reliable
research practices in ecology and evolution. The project was nominated by
Eduardo Santos, a SORTEE member, and selected by the SORTEE Awards Committee;
the award was announced during the closing session of the SORTEE Annual
Virtual Conference.

The book teaches the full workflow of ecological data analysis in R and is
freely available in Portuguese at
[analises-ecologicas.com](https://analises-ecologicas.com), with its datasets
distributed in the companion [ecodados](../../software.qmd#ecodados) package.
